body:
Changes requested: the current diff is a useful name-alias increment, but does not yet deliver the SOU-67 binding contract described in the issue/PR completion claim.

Independent exact-head offline build and both new tests passed. An additional production-parser witness confirmed that a bounded original create schema with a nested destination path is accepted by InputSchema::read but rejected by NativeState::from_bytes as invalid operator create-file policy. The unchanged exact create_file_schema digest and /path checks still enforce the old fixed argument shape.

Please add the separate additive, versioned original-tool binding and validator required by SOU-67: explicit operation, path/content selectors (including the supported direct/nested forms), supported response contract, executor identity and limits; derive and bind any internal projection to the original admitted arguments without renaming or rewriting the host frame. Reject ambiguous/overlapping selectors, unsupported extra effects and schema drift. Preserve the legacy profiles and current confinement/Ask/Deny/receipt limits.

The new read test proves an actual custom-name read and zero child dispatch. The create test proves native authorization only: it ends after release/binding assertions and does not run the actual collector or inspect a created file. Before marking this delivered, add an owned collector create/refusal demo with actual filesystem and hostile-child witnesses plus the required replay, no-overwrite, replacement/symlink, cancellation and post-commit withholding controls. Include operator migration/support notes and exact-source evidence; none are added in this PR.

Keep SOU-67 In Progress and remove the completion claim until the full scoped delivery is reviewable. No approval or merge while these gaps and current-head CI/security checks remain.
